articles.title: US envoys meet with Putin in Moscow on Ukraine talks, then head for Dublin to see Zelenskyy
articles.description: U.S. envoys have met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin and then headed to Ireland to talk with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as Washington seeks new momentum in peace efforts. Envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner brokered talks this week between delegations from Moscow and Kyiv. The meeting in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, brought the first direct discussions between Ukrainian and Russian representatives in nine months as the push for a settlement stalled. Although no major breakthroughs occurred, they agreed on a large prisoner swap. The U.S. and Zelenskyy want Europe involved in negotiations, but Russia opposes this. In Ukraine, meanwhile, fighting continues along the front line between forces from Kyiv and Moscow.

articles.title: US envoys in Moscow for meeting with Putin following talks in Abu Dhabi
articles.description: Envoys for U.S. President Donald Trump have arrived in Moscow to discuss U.S.-mediated talks between Russia and Ukraine. Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff attended negotiations in Abu Dhabi, which ended Wednesday with an agreement on a prisoner exchange. However, no significant progress was made on ending the nearly five-year conflict. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy welcomed the prisoner exchange but insisted Ukraine will not cede territory for peace. Russia and Ukraine remain divided on key issues, including postwar security and European involvement in talks. Kushner aims to include European countries in future discussions.
